descriptor_setup.pencil: A-zP with A=A^times as a rigged selfadjoint relation and P=P^times>=0

weighted_3cell.derivation: apply the Green identity to the two homogeneous descriptor solutions; the spectral terms differ by z-conjugate(w) and retain P
weighted_3cell.difference_from_ordinary: the positive apex is the P-weighted energy, not the full Hilbert norm

singular_weight.null_sector: the frozen constant source coordinate has zero spectral weight
singular_weight.strictness: u_z cannot vanish because the forced equation would imply Phi=0
singular_weight.conclusion: although P is singular, every nonzero forced Evans state has strictly positive P-weight

conditional_confinement.result: Im z=0 for the Evans state
conditional_confinement.meaning: singularity alone does not obstruct the positivity argument; only P-null characteristic states would escape

actual_symmetry_defect.raw_tail: the source forcing is one-way/triangular, with B_Phi:C->E but no reverse row
actual_symmetry_defect.formal_problem: A is not selfadjoint as a relation, so the weighted Weyl identity acquires an interior asymmetry residual
actual_symmetry_defect.canonical_reverse: the rigged transpose B_Phi^times:E'->C, lambda maps to lambda(Phi), exists independently of a Hilbert metric
actual_symmetry_defect.required_completion: insert B_Phi and B_Phi^times as opposite off-diagonal entries on the test-dual rigging, then prove a closed selfadjoint linear-relation realization
actual_symmetry_defect.operator_shadow: this is precisely the missing conservative lower incidence/backreaction row previously denoted B^dagger

defective_identity.residual: R_asym is the pairing defect between the forward source incidence and the absent/retyped reverse incidence
defective_identity.target: B_Phi^times makes R_asym=0 at the rigged level; a Green metric is needed only to realize its Hilbert shadow

higher_coherence_effect: The higher 3-cell survives passage from regular operators to singular descriptor systems by replacing the norm with P-energy. The missing top coherence is exactly the symmetrization mate between forward forcing and rigged transpose. It is not necessary to give the frozen source coordinate artificial spectral weight.
next_iteration: Write the 2x2 rigged descriptor block with B_Phi and B_Phi^times, compute its Green identity explicitly, and identify whether the source-channel equation imposed by the reverse row is compatible with the Evans normalization c=1 or introduces an additional arithmetic balance condition.
iteration_result: The singular pencil admits the correct weighted Weyl identity in principle, and the Evans state has strictly positive weighted energy. The decisive obstruction is not singular P but failure of the raw triangular source operator to be selfadjoint. The canonical rigged transpose supplies the only variance-correct reverse row; its resulting source-channel equation is the next gate.
